outcome: A dungeon card enters the game only through a venture into the dungeon and is never part of the deck.
Venturing without a dungeon in the command zone puts a chosen owned dungeon into the command zone.
A dungeon brought into the game is put into the command zone.
A dungeon card cannot be cast and does not leave the command zone except by leaving the game.
An effect other than venturing that would bring a dungeon into the game does nothing and the dungeon stays outside the game.
A player cannot bring a second dungeon into the game while owning one in the command zone.
A dungeon entering the command zone gets its owner's venture marker on the topmost room.
note: Venture marker position is not in any record.

outcome: Moving the venture marker into a room triggers that room's ability, controlled by the dungeon's owner.
Venturing moves the marker to the next room along an arrow when it is not on the bottommost room.
note: Venture marker position is not in any record.

outcome: Venturing from the bottommost room removes that dungeon from the game, then puts a new chosen dungeon into the command zone with the marker on its topmost room.
note: Venture marker position is not in any record.

outcome: A dungeon whose marker is on its bottommost room and that is not the source of a pending room ability is removed from the game in the state-based check.
A dungeon removed from the game counts as completed.
